LanguageData.LP_DivineInfusion.degreeDatas.colorE08A3: [PAWN_nameDef] carries the divine power of Bane the tyrant (servant of the tyrant): mind resistance +20%; companions within 8 cells don't flee because someone fell; melee hits have a 15% chance to cow the target for 5 seconds (move speed ×0.7, can't fire). Trigger chance rises during the Year of Twilight.

[PAWN_nameDef] carries the divine power of Surtur, king of fire giants (ember blood): fire damage taken halved, can't be ignited; melee hits add 4 burn damage with a 10% chance to ignite the target. Burns are heavier during the Year of Twilight.

[PAWN_nameDef] can hear the whispers of Ilsensine (whisperer): mind resistance +30%, can see invisible units such as those in psionic concealment; when knocked down, psychically jolts the attacker, stunning for 2 seconds. Stuns last longer during the Year of Twilight.

[PAWN_nameDef]'s eyes carry the divine power of Tyr, god of justice (eye of the law): sees through invisibility; +10% damage against targets with many crimes (humanlike kills, organ harvesting, cannibalism totaling ≥5; liches and necromantic constructs count outright). The bonus is higher during the Year of Twilight.

[PAWN_nameDef] is favored by Lathander, god of dawn (child of the dawn): one wound heals 3 per hour; +25% damage against undead; the first time downed, 30% chance to get up at once and stop bleeding. Easier to get up during the Year of Twilight.

[PAWN_nameDef] is a favorite of the lich-queen Vlaakith: astral jump cooldown halved; when taking a lethal wound, 20% chance to astral jump 8 cells away and dodge the hit. Easier to dodge during the Year of Twilight.
[PAWN_nameDef] carries the wrath of Talos, god of storms (storm's fury): EMP doesn't stun them; ranged hits have an 8% chance to add a small EMP. Trigger chance rises during the Year of Twilight.

[PAWN_nameDef] carries the beast blood of Malar, god of the hunt: move speed +10%, unaffected by darkness at night; melee hits have a 15% chance to tear open a bleeding wound. Trigger chance rises during the Year of Twilight.
